description: Information-return reporting thresholds for payments made in calendar year 2026 (1099-NEC / 1099-MISC boxes tracked by the app).
sources: One Big Beautiful Bill Act (Pub. L. 119-21), amending IRC §6041(a) and §6041A: threshold raised from $600 to $2,000 for payments made after December 31, 2025 (inflation-indexed after 2026)
